PC Errata 2016 disc card of [[IG-88's Pulse Cannon]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 12 March 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/ig88spulsecannon.gif ig88spulsecannon.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160312144247/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/ig88spulsecannon.gif Internet Archive] (12 March 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 7 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261007071830/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/ig88spulsecannon.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[IG-88's Pulse Cannon (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].
